purpose: Compare the authenticated 24 TRAIN provenance rows against 32 existing E38 original-byte snapshot hashes, with no source/quality/remote reads.
stable_read: Reuse frozen E54 stable ordinary-single-link non-reparse file reader; verify each complete JSON byte SHA before decoding the metadata-only projection. Reject duplicate JSON keys. No wildcard paths or embedded-path following.
identity: Exact circuit + stage alias + source_sha256 joins E38 circuit + stage_alias + sha256. normalized_sha256 is retained separately and NEVER used to rescue a raw-hash miss. Matching raw hash with contradictory row_count rejects the entire comparison.
metadata_grain: Exactly 24 unique six-TRAIN by four-stage source records, preserving provenance row order/ordinals; compare all 32 inventory entries, retain their order and all coverage roots.
multiple_policy: Retain every matching location and reference count. Identical bytes at multiple roots do not identify a physical original path, invocation or cost lineage. Do not default to v2, choose fastest or merge locations.
basename_policy: Only report basename equality as weak metadata; copied flat names may differ from original A layout names. Never use basename alone for identity or reject a valid hash match solely for name difference.
output: 24 metadata-only rows with all matching location metadata, class counts, all 32 inventory references including unused entries, byte-found/physical-unique flags. Zero matches remain explicit, not rewritten as successful source authentication.
input_provenance_binding: E54 full receipt SHA matches package candidate_receipt anchor; provenance full SHA matches receipt bound source_provenance field. E55 proves only equality to recorded E38 snapshot bytes, not original-disk readback now or historical execution time.
actual_execution_gate: Synthetic tests and independent review before exactly one fixed-input local comparison. No raw source files, A/B hosts, ACLs, checkpoints, BLIND or quality values.
